topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: When my sister and I received the letter informing us that we had inherited our grandmother's house, I couldn't help but replay the words in my head, trying to fully grasp what this meant. It's such a big responsibility, and I'm not sure where to start. The house has so much history, so many memories. I know we have to make some big decisions, like whether to keep it or sell it. I just hope we can reach an agreement that honors our grandmother's memory. Maybe we should start by cleaning out the attic. I think that might give us some clarity on what to do next. It feels like a big step, but I suppose every journey starts with a single step, right?
